description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityConditionValue' used as a base for representing condition expression values in the OFBiz entity framework. It includes nested classes, methods for SQL generation, value retrieval, and validation, and references several OFBiz-specific classes.

classes.name: EntityConditionValue
classes.description: Abstract base class for condition expression values, supporting SQL generation, value retrieval, and validation.
